notes.title: Battlewake Patch v1.0.1 Now Live!
notes.notes:
Avast, all ye PC pirates! We just unleashed [i]Battlewake[/i] patch v1.0.1 for Steam and Oculus players, which includes fixes for PvP, weapons, and more. Here are the full patch notes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35024634/a34ed8dd09d2b2d8ac16027de53af8ba848acb1d.gif[/img]

[u][b]Patch Notes for [i]Battlewake[/i] v1.0.1 (released October 22, 2019)[/b][/u][list]
[*] Various crash and stability improvements
[*] [i]Calibration:[/i] Fixed an issue where player would be calibrated incorrectly when using some HMD types
[*] [i]Weapons:[/i] Fixed an issue that caused weapon spread/accuracy to be incorrect on nearby enemies
[*] [i]Voice Chat:[/i] Fixed an issue where Voice Chat Mute button would not function correctly
[*] [i]Plunder PvP:[/i] Resolved an issue that displayed incorrect Health for users before they are damaged
[*] [i]Plunder PvP:[/i] Fixed an issue that caused late-joining players to lose weapon functionality
[/list]
Thank ye all for yer patience, and please keep sending us whatever foul bugs you encounter on your voyages to [url=mailto:support@survios.com]support@survios.com[/url]!

notes.title: Pledge the Pirate's Life: $1,000 Community Challenge!
notes.notes:
September 19 is a date pirates ’round the world hold close to their plundering hearts, for avast! It is none other than International Talk Like a Pirate Day, ye scurvy landlubber. And to commemorate this momentous occasion, we're gathering all our V-ARRRRR pirates are here together on this important holiday, we have an incredibly important proposal for you all: [b]BOOTY.[/b] This Talk Like a Pirate Day, [b][url=www.pledgethepirateslife.com]Pledge the Pirate's Life[/url] together[/b] in an exciting collaborative community event where everyone wins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35024634/41eb35d24f5feba11316723a7786780a17790f79.png[/img]

From today, September 19, through September 29, ye have but two simple tasks:
[olist]
[*][url=www.pledgethepirateslife.com]Pledge the Pirate’s life by visiting this site[/url], then
[*]jump into Battlewake and get sinking as many ships in multiplayer as ye can.
[/olist]
That’s it! Like the watchful eye of Andromalius, we’ll be keeping track of how much chaos you all wreak together, and as you obtain greater accomplishments, so too do the rewards become all the richer:
[list]
[*][b]Sink 50,000 Ships:[/b] Digital swag pack (for all participating pirates!)
[*][b]Sink 100,000 Ships:[/b] [i]Battlewake[/i] t-shirt/sticker packs (25 scurvy sea-dogs)
[*][b]Sink 150,000 Ships:[/b] $50 Steam/PlayStation giftcards (your choice, 10 lucky landlubbers)
[*][b]Sink 250,000 Ships:[/b] $1,000 USD (1 Grand Prize!)
[/list]
Yarrrr, but how does this work?! Ye ask, scratchin’ yer skull. ’Tis simple: every day, we’re tracking the total number of ships sunk across all game modes and platforms, including Plunder PvP, and updating the total on [url=www.pledgethepirateslife.com]this landing page[/url]. As ye unlock each tier, you’ll be entered into a random drawing to win! And to make achieving this just a tad bit simpler, we've set up PvP Happy Hours:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35024634/37fe926fa42055faa3f31b0b4e170d53362ad574.png[/img]

For more details, including official rules, visit the [url=www.pledgethepirateslife.com]Pledge the Pirate’s Life website[/url] and [url=discord.gg/survios]join the official Survios Discord[/url] to get connected in the Captains’ Quarters! And get pumped with this recap of our launch week featuring pirates like you:
https://youtu.be/qZbYy0xlcXM

notes.title: The Seas are Yours: Battlewake Now Available
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35024634/f2986f66b06117ed8f6565240ecb3b5e6cdf5a01.png[/img]

After months of anticipation, including a bombastic PC beta, Survios's new VR game [i]Battlewake[/i] is available now for $29.99, with an additional 15% launch discount! Watch the official launch trailer:
https://youtu.be/8Evthrfr91s
The Seas of New Urth constantly churn with the raging surge of battle. The treacherous Queen’s Company has taken your lands, your freedom, your riches, your power. Once squabbling towards extinction, the Pirate Lords now join forces to destroy their common foe, bound in blood by the demon Andromalius. They must regain their seas, avenge their families, take back their riches, and restore their world, with the fate of New Urth hanging in the balance. But will greed prevail?

Set your course for September 19, for not only is it a very important holiday for all pirates around the world, but it’s also the start of a thrilling community event that we can’t wait to share! Get your plunderin’ parties assembled over at [url=discord.gg/survios]the official Survios Discord[/url], and we’ll see you all upon the high seas…

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/KyGI9aJVFDxkXrNATF/giphy.gif[/img]

[u][b]Known Day 1 Issues[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] [i]Multiplayer[/i] - Players default to Diego when choosing a Pirate Lord after already playing multiplayer once
[*] [i]Multiplayer[/i] - Player will sometimes load into a Lobby or Match for a second time
[*] [i]Multiplayer[/i] - Enemy vessels will jump forward, desyncing position
[*] [i]VFX[/i] - Players cannot see ability projections when preparing special abilities
[*] [i]VFX[/i] - Zhang's and boss ships’ mortar VFX fire is observed floating midair away from the ship
[*] [i]UI[/i] - Some boss ships have two Destroy objective markers above them
[*] [i]Plunder[/i] - Upon respawning, the Helm can be observed falling from the sky
[*] [i]Plunder[/i] - The Flamethrower on Rev Ship's can damage itself
[*] [i]Warfare [Multiplayer][/i] - Sometimes, friendly ships appear to jitter during a Warfare match
[*] [i]Campaign[/i] - Client loses skull scores after closing the application
[*] [i]Campaign[/i] - Earning 1 skull does not display on the rack-up screen
[*] [i]Campaign [Multiplayer][/i] - The client will not unlock the trophy for clearing a Captain's campaign missions
[*] [i]Environment[/i] - Players are not taking damage from volcano meteors
[/list]

notes.title: Battlewake Closed Beta Set for July 19-21 on Steam
notes.notes:
Landlubbers and sea dogs alike: ’tis time to heed the call of the Boatman. All courses are plotted for the [i]Battlewake[/i] Closed Beta to officially set sail July 19-21―yes, that’s this weekend!―on Steam for HTC Vive and Oculus Rift+Touch players!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35024634/023bd0fbb7f41b717f3d2c4691bd005143f2f0b1.jpg[/img]

The [i]Battlewake[/i] Closed Beta will start at 12pm PST on Friday, July 19, and run through 11:59pm PST on Sunday, July 21. [url=www.battlewake.com]Beta signups will remain open through 12pm PST on July 18[/url], and beta participants will receive installation instructions via email the morning of July 19 (be sure to check your spam folders!).

The Battlewake Closed Beta will feature one playable game mode: Warfare, a cooperative, progressive gauntlet that supports 1-4 players. Choose your Pirate Lord ([url=https://survios.com/studio/introducing-battlewakes-pirate-lords/]meet the mystical quartet in this blog post![/url]), accept missions and battle enemies across a variety of lush elemental environments. Along the way, you’ll earn gold to upgrade your ship and abilities before embarking on your next adventure.

Watch Warfare Mode in action in this yarrrrrrr-some video made by our friends at [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/Node]NODE[/url]:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n6qP7VwxhN4
Now all that’s left it is to get in the seafaring spirit! Brush up on [url=https://survios.com/studio/introducing-battlewakes-pirate-lords/]the four playable Pirate Lords[/url], [url=discord.gg/survios]join the official Survios Discord[/url] to find your crew, and be sure to add [i]Battlewake[/i] to your Steam wishlist. We’ll see you ’pon the high seas soon!

notes.title: Announcing Battlewake!
notes.notes:
Survios is thrilled to unveil its newest title: [i]Battlewake[/i], a rip-roaring, high-seas vehicular combat adventure developed exclusively for V-aRRRRRRR! And right now, you can wishlist [i]Battlewake[/i] right here on Steam and [url=http://www.battlewake.com]sign up for the upcoming Closed Beta[/url] prior to its Summer 2019 release.
https://youtu.be/qhre5zGqDS0
It’s been the pirate’s life for us over the past year as [i]Battlewake[/i] dominated our development slate. Never content without a challenge, we wanted to tackle an entirely new genre for us—vehicular locomotion—and then, of course, we settled on high-seas combat like the masochistic nerds that we are. (Okay, so we may have also just wanted to make a pirate game, because—why not?!)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35024634/06e2b0ac881f8f7c377e769dec6d9a29ca3b4da2.jpg[/img]

[i]Battlewake[/i] transforms you into four fearsome, super-powered Pirate Lords locked in a constant struggle for dominion over the lush landscapes of New Urth. Each is a figure of myth and might, fiercely devoted to their plundering way of life and the riches it brings in both spirit and treasure. You’ll find out more about each Pirate Lord’s unique backstory and magics in future features!

In the heat of battle, along with captaining an upgradable ship stocked with weapons such as flak cannons, chain cannons, ballistae, mortars, and axe-throwers, you can also channel the Pirate Lords’ ancient powers to stir up exhilarating and devastating chaos. Turn the tide in your favor with massive ultimates: unleash mighty tsunamis, send enemies’ ships flying in maelstroms, destroy hulls with bone spikes, and literally release the Kraken.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35024634/621c6984b59145c04893df9b00ef19f748d07c84.jpg[/img]

[i]Battlewake[/i] has several game modes to satisfy every kind of VR gamer. Navigate the epic 20-chapter story of the Pirate Lords’ quest to discover an ancient seat of power in solo/co-op Campaign Mode, or work together to complete co-op objectives in dynamic Warfare Mode. Want to fully embrace the pirate’s life? A plunderin’ free-for-all PvP deathmatch is your heart’s desire in Plunder Mode (along with the gold you’ll loot from the ships you sink)!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35024634/5adc0ee9df3d58f96e292fdcbacfcaf0096700ea.jpg[/img]

Don’t have your sea legs? Have no fear! Much like [i]Sprint Vector[/i]’s Fluid Locomotion and [i]CREED: Rise to Glory[/i]’s Phantom Melee, [i]Battlewake[/i] is powered by our latest technology: the Immersive Vehicle System™. Designed to neutralize seasickness, IVS lets you experience your ship’s every pitch, yaw, ram, and plunge upon the tumultuous waves without feeling like a landlubber.

[b]Ready to seize the wheel of your destiny? Heed the Boatman’s call: [url=http://www.battlewake.com]sign up now for [i]Battlewake[/i]’s Closed Beta[/url] and wishlist it on Steam![/b]
